SELECT distinct A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, A.FINPROD_NAME text, nvl(A.FINPROD_ABBR,'') || ','|| nvl(A.FINPROD_NAME,'') || ',' || nvl(A.FINPROD_ID,'') || ',' || nvl(B.UNITVALUE_DEC,'') || ',' || nvl(to_char(C.PUR_SPEED),'')||','|| nvl(A.CCY,'') ||','|| nvl(to_char(A.VDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd'),'') || ',' || nvl(to_char(A.MDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd'),'')|| ',' || nvl(C.IS_CYCLE,'')|| ',' || nvl(A.OPERATION_TYPE,'')|| ',' || nvl(A.PROFIT_TYPE,'')|| ',' || nvl(PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID,'') || ',' ||
nvl(C.DEAL_MODE,'') || ',' ||
nvl(A.CALENDAR_ID,'') || ',' ||
nvl(C.TERM_TYPE,'') || ',' || nvl(PSP.CONTINUE_FLAG,'')||','
|| nvl(A.LIQUIDATION_YESNO,'') object
FROM FIN_PRODUCT A
INNER JOIN PTL_MANAGE_OBJ PTL ON PTL.MANAGE_OBJ_ID = A.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY PTLAUTH ON PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTLAUTH.PORTFOLIO_ID INNER JOIN PRD_SALE_PARAM PSP ON A.FINPROD_ID = PSP.FINPROD_ID, PRD_VAL_PARAM B,FIN_PRODUCT_ADD C WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F16, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
AND A.PROFIT_TYPE in
#{item, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
AND C.ISSUE_STATUS IN (#{ISSUE_STATUS_01, jdbcType = VARCHAR}, #{ISSUE_STATUS_03, jdbcType = VARCHAR})
AND A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search}),'%')
AND A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{initValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND PTLAUTH.USER_ID = #{userName}
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT DEAL.FINPROD_ID FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL DEAL WHERE DEAL.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID AND DEAL.PS IN (#{PS_C20},#{PS_C5}) AND DEAL.IS_CANCEL = #{isCancel} AND nvl(DEAL.P_TRADE_ID,'null')='null' )

SELECT fin_trade_product.period_id id, fin_trade_product.period_id text, nvl(fin_trade_product.term_type,'') || ',' || trim(nvl(char(cast(fin_trade_product.term as decimal(8,0))),'')) || ',' ||trim(char(cast(fin_trade_product.branch as decimal(10,0)))) || ',' || ( '20' || substr(fin_trade_product.mdate, instr(fin_trade_product.mdate, '-', 1, 2) + 1, 2) || '-' || to_char(fin_trade_product.mdate,'MM') || '-' || right(fin_trade_product.mdate,2) ) object FROM fin_trade_product left JOIN fin_product ON fin_product.finprod_id = fin_trade_product.finprod_id WHERE FIN_PRODUCT.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.VDATE = #{vDate,jdbcType=DATE}

select CDATE,TDY_UNIT_VALUE from (SELECT row_number() over() as rownum, CDATE,TDY_UNIT_VALUE FROM BOK_POSITION_PRD WHERE finprod_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND BRANCH = #{branch,jdbcType=INTEGER} AND CDATE <= #{cDate,jdbcType=DATE} ORDER BY CDATE DESC) where rownum=1
